- PARTY BUNTING added £1,541.70 WoW and JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT added £1,362.00 WoW, the largest absolute gains.
- JUMBO BAG SCANDINAVIAN BLUE PAISLEY rose 307.0% WoW, ASSORTED COLOURS SILK FAN 224.9% WoW, and JUMBO BAG OWLS 191.6% WoW.
